# SenditGo

> SenditGo is intelligent transport management for local and last-mile
> fleets, launching 2027. SenditGo’s AI, SAM, weighs thousands of combinations across
> every stop, window and driver, then hands back a dispatch-ready plan in seconds.
> Early access is open now.

Set the outcome. Fleet-wide intelligence handles the rest. Every driver, route and
delivery stays live in one clear view.

## Product
- [Home / overview](https://www.senditgo.com/): What SenditGo is — intelligent transport management, launching 2027, with routing, proof of delivery, total fleet oversight, an operations deck and live tracking in one connected system.
- [Get early access](https://www.senditgo.com/contact): Contact SenditGo about early access.
- [Driver app](https://www.senditgo.com/install): Install the SenditGo driver app for iOS or Android.

## Company & policies
- [Contact](https://www.senditgo.com/contact): Contact SenditGo — book a product demo, ask about plans and pricing, integrations, or finding the right solution.
- [Data safety](https://www.senditgo.com/data-safety): How SenditGo handles operational and location data.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.senditgo.com/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Account deletion](https://www.senditgo.com/account-deletion): How to delete an account and associated data.

## Notes
- Status: launching 2027; early access is open now.
- Core capabilities: automated delivery planning and route optimisation, live GPS fleet tracking, dynamic driver rosters / run orders, paperless electronic proof of delivery (ePOD), real-time order status updates, customer-facing live tracking, driver mobile app.
- Audience: fleet operators, last-mile and local delivery companies (English-first; APAC/Taiwan).
